verdict.rationale: Motion exposes a documented REST API (api.usemotion.com) with API-key auth for creating/updating tasks and projects, and a probe confirms the API is live and enforces authentication — this is usable headlessly from scripts or CI pipelines. However, there is no evidence of a CLI, SDK, webhooks, or explicit CI/automation examples/cookbooks tailored to headless execution. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/automation documentation, official SDKs or CLI tools, and independent confirmation of API use in automated pipelines.
